review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the 119 daily counts of archived triggers at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 and on a deterministic analysis whose 37 self-checks pass. AIC and BIC rank negative binomial, geometric, Poisson (43.21 and 40.431 points between the first two); a seeded check of independent days shows how often each criterion picks the true model at 15 to 119 days. The ranking rests on four days in two episodes, the winner misfits the common counts, and the days are not independent (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.4587), so the draft calls the negative binomial the least bad of three, not a description of the process. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
